questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Sweden?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter S and has 9 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Sweden article.

questions.proof: Sweden's capital city is Stockholm, which is also Sweden's largest city, with almost one million people.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Sweden?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter D and has 7 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “History” part of the Sweden article.

questions.proof: In the 15th century, during the Kalmar Union, Sweden had the same king as Denmark and Norway.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Sweden?

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter S and has 7 letters.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Sweden article.

questions.proof: Sweden has an official majority language, Swedish (the Swedish word for the language is svenska).

questions.prompt: What money is used in Sweden?

hints.nudge: It is 2 words long and starts with the letter S.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Sweden article.

questions.proof: The currency remains the Swedish krona (Swedish crown).

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Sweden had taken _____, Latvia, and Finland and parts of Norway, Germany, and Russia.”

hints.nudge: It starts with the letter E and has 7 letters.
